comment: ANCHOR: STALE_N8N_WRITERS_LQ104_20261107 — LQ-20261107-104, five scheduled writers whose stores stopped moving
while their logs said everything was fine: the agenda's duplicate scheduler fire flipped a good receipt to
failed; the incubator screener screened 0 of 10 and exited 0; both reconcilers called a permanently empty
input a clean run; and the RI queue left a row 'running' for 89 days with no process behind it. Each is pinned
here by the decision it now makes. Hermetic: fake cursors/modules, no database, no network, no model call.
